abstract: Secure Zoom Meeting SDK guidance encoding auth and configuration defaults: server-side-only SDK JWT signature generation (HS256, 2-hour TTL, 30-second clock-skew backdating, server-decided role), standardized ZOOM_MEETING_SDK_KEY/ZOOM_MEETING_SDK_SECRET credentials stored per environment (.env locally, managed secret store in deployed environments), Java Spring MVC and Node.js signature-endpoint variants, Component View as the default web embed, and mandatory logging redaction and test coverage.
